_about: Public-domain Frank Milton Bristol, Methodist Episcopal bishop, for the Word Hoard: Providential Epochs, The Ministry of Art, The Religious Instinct of Man, The Life of Chaplain McCabe, Heroines of History, and a funeral sermon. His Shakespeare studies are left out. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 126 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken.

bristol-funeral-hayes: Sermon preached at the funeral of Samuel J. Hayes, superintendent of machinery of the Illinois Central R.R., September 25, A.D. 1882 (Chicago : Rand, McNally & Co., printers, 1882)

bristol-mccabe: The life of Chaplain McCabe : bishop of the Methodist Episcopal Church (Cincinnati : Jennings and Graham ; New York : Eaton & Mains, 1908)
bristol-heroines: Heroines of history : typical heroines of mythology of Shakespeare, of the Bible (New York : Abingdon Press, 1914)
